neighbours.label: the full stop ending a sentence that announces something new or first ("I'm new here.", "my first post.", "its first book.")
fire: Hello everyone, this is my very first blog post. Please be kind.
It seems you are new to our forum. Feel free to introduce yourself.
The company opened its first store in Ohio last week. More are planned.
I just joined this community today. I hope to learn a lot here.
The author's debut novel has finally been translated into English. It sold out quickly.
We launched a brand new podcast this month. The first episode is out now.
This was the first time she had ever flown on a plane. She loved it.
Welcome, you are a new member here. Read the rules before posting.
quiet: Hello everyone, this blog post is about baking bread, please be kind
It seems you are logged in to our forum, so feel free to post
The company closed a store in Ohio last week, and others may follow
I visited this community today and hope to come back soon
The author's novel is still sold mainly in Spanish, and it sells slowly
We recorded a long podcast this month about gardening and soil
She flies on planes for work most weeks and finds it tiring
Members should read the rules carefully before posting

notes: Top 32: '.' x14, mostly closing short intro or news ledes ('It looks like you're new here.', 'This is my first post with WordPress.'). Probe: 'my first post on this blog.' 0.49 vs a council-budget lede 0.07. The - pole fires before ordinals ('This is my | third baby'), and the + pole's output suppresses ordinals. Near misses: same style of opening sentence without newness or firstness.
